Modern neural networks provide competing and potentially complementary geometric representations. Published behavioral fits do not identify a unique mental program or physiological construction rule.

The 2026 comparison has independently recomputed deposited readouts and a selected offline check. Layer mixing affects several joint fits, but the leading DINOv3-small plus description result remains. Al Roumi et al. 2023 compares a chosen binary repetition language with a limited set of models; Alternate bracketing is an exception. Its neural violation classifier does not decode a full program or establish the proposed prefrontal prediction pathway.
